summary: End-to-end backend + frontend test of NJE Product Catalogue. 31/31 pytest backend tests pass (health, auth, categories CRUD, products CRUD + filter/search/sort, meta, analytics, upload). All admin UI pages (login, dashboard, products, categories, analytics, product form) render with expected data-testids and INR pricing. Product detail page shows item_number and ₹ correctly (verified via screenshot).

issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on mount before its parent measures. Chart renders correctly, but console warnings are noisy — consider setting minHeight/minWidth or explicit height on ResponsiveContainer parent.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) The problem statement mentions item_number pattern 'NJE-shop-admin-pro-9-{num}'; actual seeded/live pattern is 'NJE-<CategorySlug>-<NNN>' (e.g., NJE-Silver-001, NJE-Earrings-001). This appears intentional (uses category slug from DEMO_CATEGORIES) — verify the docstring/PRD wording with product; no code fix needed.
(Optional) Suppress Recharts responsive-container width/height warnings by wrapping the chart container in a div with defined min-height.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~750 lines and monolithic — consider splitting into modules (auth, products, categories, upload, analytics) for maintainability. Not blocking.
Login endpoint returns token in body AND sets httpOnly cookie: OK for hybrid Bearer/cookie strategy, but cookie is secure=true, samesite=none which requires HTTPS (fine on preview). Verified working.
bcrypt hash generated with $2b$ prefix confirmed working (login test passes).
seed_admin correctly updates existing admin password if .env password changes (line 688-694).
put_object/get_object re-init on 403 is a nice recovery mechanism.
No brute-force lockout logic present — auth just returns 401 on wrong password. Playbook mentions 'lockout after 5 fails' but this app does not implement it. Not tested; flagging for main agent.
seed_data_creation: Used seeded 6 categories + 8 products only. Test-created data (TEST_* products and one stray 'Anon Attempt' category / 'Anon' product from an initial fixture issue) was cleaned up post-run. DB restored to 8 products + 6 categories.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses cookie AND bearer for auth. When writing tests, use a FRESH requests.Session for unauthenticated assertions — the shared session picks up the httpOnly access_token cookie after login and becomes admin, causing false 200s on 'unauthorized' tests. Item numbers follow NJE-<CategorySlug>-<NNN> (per-slug counter in db.counters). Object storage (Emergent) upload works and image is served via /api/files/{path}. Frontend data-testids used: product-grid, product-card-<id>, filter-sidebar, price-range-slider, search-input, sort-select, results-count, login-form/email/password/submit/error, btn-add-category, btn-save-product, image-dropzone, chart-per-category, chart-price-distribution, stat-total-products, stat-total-categories, select-all-checkbox, row-checkbox-<id>.
